checks.explanation: The frontier AI landscape has not converged into fewer models: distinct major model families from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, xAI, Meta, DeepSeek, and Alibaba continue to proliferate, but within any single lab's own lineup, general-purpose models have absorbed capabilities (coding, vision, agentic tool use) that once required separate specialized models, partially matching the prediction.

The pattern held for the next generation: Gemini's free tier now runs on Gemini 3 Flash, which benchmarks ahead of the prior generation's paid Gemini 2.5 Pro tier on most agentic tasks, while the new Gemini 3.1 Pro was moved behind a paywall.
